svg.text: Every connection, generated from cad/spec.py (pin table: docs/wiring.md)
CSI | 22-pin 0.5 mm FPC via right hinge
Brow bay | 5 V + GND from PowerBoost
Flags: a red arrow is a power net, the bars are ground;
'pin N' names the Pi header pin that net is wired to.
Dots on a lane = one Pi pin feeding two devices (shared I2S clocks).
